caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a goat or antelope, rendered in brown tones with detailed texture to suggest fur. The animal has two long, curved black horns and pointed ears. Its body appears to be made of wood, and it is adorned with decorative harnesses and saddle. The harness around its neck and chest is green, edged in yellow, and accented with red flower designs and some black contour lines. The saddle is tan with a brown seat and yellow-green sides, decorated with red and green floral patterns and blue swirls. The animal is shown in a dynamic, standing pose with its front right leg raised and its back left leg slightly lifted. The background is a plain light beige, and there is no other object or scenery present in the composition.
title: Hobby Goat
